prerequisites: Empresa I. Sistemas y Procesos de Fabricación (Business I. Manufacturing Systems and Processes)

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, studies, reports, work plans and other similar tasks.
Ability to handle specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.
Ability to apply quality principles and methods.
Ability to organize and plan within the scope of the company, and other institutions and organizations.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.

Ability to apply knowledge of occupational safety and health, prevention of occupational risks and machine safety, according to current regulations on passive and active fire protection, and aspects of acoustic pollution.
Basic knowledge of production and manufacturing systems.
Knowledge and skills to organize and manage projects. Knowing the organizational structure and functions of a project office.
Critically and constructively evaluate the advantages and opportunities of different solutions to the same problem.
Solve complex problems autonomously within the discipline.
Draw conclusions from practical or experimental work and research carried out autonomously.

syllabus_topics: General concepts of production and manufacturing systems
Classification and components of Production Systems
Organization chart of a production company
teaching_methods: Participative classes (case studies, role-playing, exercises, presentations, debates)
assessment_rules: The final grade (N_F) is calculated as 0.5 multiplied by the written exam grade (N_PE), plus 0.25 multiplied by the academic work and observation grade (N_EO), plus 0.25 multiplied by the integrated project grade (N_PI). For the written exams, it is necessary to obtain a minimum grade of 4 to average with other grades. The course is passed if the final grade (N_F) is 5 or higher, and the written exam grade (N_PE) is not below 4. In a second examination opportunity, only the written exam grade can be recovered, while other grades are respected. Students exempt from the Integrated Project will have their final grade calculated as 0.75 multiplied by N_PE plus 0.25 multiplied by N_EO.
